up: Retrieve the precise activity measurements (standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type) for all compounds evaluated in the assay designated by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649947. Additionally, provide the canonical SMILES and the ChEMBL identifier of each tested compound. Only include records where the activity relation is '=' (exact) and the standard_value is not null.
sql: SELECT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649947' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
